fact: Zambia's national report to UNGEGN says ZICTA's National Addressing and Postcode Project is naming streets, installing signage and building a GIS address database with local authorities, with streets named systematically in some neighbourhoods, while no national addressing policy has been approved.

The Transport minister told parliament that ZICTA's National Addressing and Postal Code System Project, begun in August 2012, was in its pilot phase in Lusaka and Livingstone areas, with national rollout planned to 2018 and a national addressing database being built.
